record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, jointly set maxlen=64, batch size=256 and learning rate=1.4e-3, retaining dropout=0.3 and AdamW with existing weight decay. Most histories fit within 64 positions; shorter tensors offset the larger batch's cost, while more sampled users reduce gradient noise and the modest learning-rate increase supports fitting within the fixed update budget. Preserve features, embedding tying, HSTU formulas, readout and loss; retain seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap. Persist matching predictor metadata.

category_rationales.rationale: For all four category models, jointly shorten maxlen to 64, double batch size to 256 and raise learning rate to 1.4e-3. Shorter sequences offset the larger batch's computation; larger batches may reduce gradient noise while the increased learning rate supports fitting within the fixed update budget. Retain dropout 0.3, AdamW and existing weight decay. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate maxlen consistently.
